caption: United States v. Figueroa
citation_line: United States v. Figueroa, No. 2:14-cr-00672; aff’d, No. 23-1742 (3d Cir. Aug. 25, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: After trial, Judge Neals entered judgment on kidnapping, aggravated sexual abuse, firearm, federal-employee assault and arson counts and imposed a 516-month sentence.
qualification_rationale: The precedential appeal resolved multiple significant criminal-law questions, including whether an unconditional guilty plea waives an otherwise preserved limitations defense and whether kidnapping “by kidnap” under 18 U.S.C. § 1201(a) requires force.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed. It expressly held, for the first time in the circuit, that an unconditional knowing and voluntary guilty plea waives appellate review of a preserved nonjurisdictional statute-of-limitations challenge; it also rejected the kidnapping-instruction and speedy-trial challenges.
